meta.criteria: F1-F4 are stated in the script docstring, written before production
meta.stage2_criteria: S1, F5, F6, F7, F3b and the plateau rule are in the docstring, written before the stage 2 runs; the plateau rule is post hoc for stage 1
meta.post_hoc: second streams at N = 6, 8, 12 on the u = 2 line and N = 16 at u = 2 were added after a 1.8 sigma fall appeared there; merged streams are one ensemble. combined_stage1_stage2, the slopes and the fall limits were added after seeing data, as descriptions
caveats: upper bound on the lowest coupled level only
operators reach the 20 states of the tree-level lowest neutral multiplet (stage 2) but nothing else by design; a level from a higher multiplet with small overlap is invisible
on the whole-lattice mean of tr W3 there are no valley flips in any ensemble, so e3-even and e3-odd neutral levels are not separated. Per slice P3(t) does change sign rarely: see valley_summary
fits use diagonal weights; chi2 is only indicative. Most channels are "unresolved" under the plateau rule, and at N >= 12 nearly all of them: see plateau_counts
N <= 16 only, with large errors at N = 16; F1 and F6 are weak tests, see detectable_fall and fall_upper_95
the stage 1 streams at N = 12 on the u = 2 line disagree at 2.4 sigma in GEVP_A: see streams. The merged error does not include this
corrections_after_review: Target A item 4 has no momentum restriction; the first docstring said zero momentum. Stage 2 adds p != 0 and mixed polarization

F4 compared unequal windows through fits.get("L/8"), although its comment said otherwise; it now compares identical windows, and its first reported closest case (2.8 sigma) is replaced by 2.57 sigma on identical windows
"the constant explains T = L" is weakened to "is a consistent account": B/A near 1.5 at u near 1 is not derived and the g^2 transition at 4.44/L was not tested
F3 in the first version checked six readouts, not "any neutral channel". It now scans every fit and lists pinned and low signal fits apart as non-fits
"the fall at u = 2 was noise" is weakened to "not reproduced", with the streams recorded separately
c(u) "4.2 to 4.9" as a plateau value is withdrawn; each value now carries a plateau status and its window spread
correlators are now centered before the FFT. This changes GEVP values by at most 0.001 but some weak coupling single Q fits by up to 0.18, always well inside their error

F4_summary.power: the comparison is resolved only in windows starting at tau = 1 or 2, which those early points dominate; at tau >= L/4 the T = L errors are large (see the same_window entries)
F4_summary.g2_transition_4_44: not tested. The docstring predicts a rate near 4.44/L at T = L only; there is no amplitude prediction and no resolved departure to attribute to it
F4_summary.constant: a constant in tau is a consistent account of the low raw T = L masses, not a derived one: B/A is near 1.5 at u near 1 and nothing here computes that value
